detail.finding: lib/ledger-fanin holds subscribers in module-level state, so it is per-process. copilot/cortex/diagnostic run as separate spawned processes. autopilot's "(deferred: intelligence,copilot)" boot line could never resolve: co-pilot subscribed to a different array in a different process.
detail.built: two-sided SSE transport carrying canonical component-ledger rows. mount() serves a process fan-in; subscribe() replays a remote stream into the local one.
detail.tests: tests/modules/test-ledger-sse.js — 17 passing, incl. a real child-process gate

intent: close the cross-process gap in the fan-in

detail.defect: component-ledger emits type=`${system}.${action}` with the real component at TOP level and status/hook/wire nested in payload. The normalizer re-derived from type, producing component:"copilot" instead of "copilot.lifeline" and turning ERROR rows into info.
detail.why_it_matters: an error arriving as info is worse than not arriving — it is wrong data that looks right
detail.caught_by: end-to-end run; unit tests passed throughout

intent: record the defect so the shape is learnable, not just the fix
